testsuite.name: Facet/matchCount parse is coupled to the retrieval leg's parse (tempdoc 821 §L.3 + §P)

testcase.name: Malformed LUCENE on a DENSE-ONLY leg still signals — the counts parse it too
No-facets multi-leg LUCENE request: computeMatchCount tallies the leg's parse
LUCENE-syntax multi-leg request: leg honours LUCENE, facets + matchCount follow it
SIMPLE-syntax multi-leg request is unchanged — and now diverges from the LUCENE one
LUCENE quoted phrase retrieves phrase matches, not a token OR — counts follow
Malformed LUCENE query: multi-leg mirrors the sparse shortcut's INVALID_ARGUMENT
